name: Rollout
description: Moving the instances that follow a channel to its new version of a package, in waves with a health gate between them that stops on the first failure (forge 20f-2). Create one to start it; set status to paused, running or aborted to pause, resume or abort it.

fields.name: Channel
fields.description: The channel whose new version it rolls out

fields.name: Wave size
fields.description: Instances per wave (1 when left out)

fields.name: Order
fields.description: Instance ids to move first, in this order; the rest follow by id

fields.name: Wave timeout
fields.description: Seconds a wave may take to report the version installed and healthy (600 when left out)

fields.name: Status
fields.description: starting until its waves are planned, then running, paused, done, failed or aborted

fields.name: To
fields.description: Reported: the version instances move to

fields.name: Wave
fields.description: Reported: the wave moving now (0 is the first)

fields.name: Wave started
fields.description: Reported: when the current wave began

fields.name: Failure
fields.description: Reported: the instance that stopped it, and why
